basic_profile.bio: VinylVoyager92 here, an avid vinyl collector from the outskirts of Boston. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a lot of flexibility to explore my hobbies. I discovered my love for vinyl records about a year ago, and since then, I've been on a mission to expand my collection. When I'm not designing or hunting for records, you can find me playing Pokemon Go around the city. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings diving into online communities, especially those related to music and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having completed a degree in visual arts. My interest in vinyl began when a friend introduced me to the rich sound quality of records, sparking a self-taught journey into music collection. I often research online, learning from forums and fellow enthusiasts.
